deck_title: Enterprise Spatial Computing (Apple Vision Pro / Meta Quest 3): Temporal Depth + Comfort Disparity Clamp [-1.8%, +2.2%] + DIBR Inpainting + MV-HEVC/USDZ (c_spatial = c_0/(1+u), 1.0000x Lock) vs Naive Unclamped 3D Sickness

cards.subtitle: Deterministic Enterprise Spatial Computing (Apple Vision Pro MV-HEVC & RealityKit USDZ / Meta Quest 3 WebXR) pipeline evaluation (extracting 120-frame temporally coherent metric depth via Video-Depth-Anything, clamping binocular disparity within [-1.8%, +2.2%] FOV, inpainting disoccluded background strips behind foreground silhouettes, and applying a floating stereo window so amortized unit cost c_spatial(u) = c_0 / (1 + u) reaches 0.5000 at u = 1.0, locking C_active / C_spatial = 1.0000x across all 17 stages u in [0.000, 1.000] with 0/17 violated) versus naive per-frame depth warping & unclamped disparity shifts (which trigger vergence-accommodation conflict nausea and rubber-sheet edge tears, inflating rework cost by 1 + u to 1.2500x at S4, 1.5000x at S8, and 2.0000x at S16 across 16/17 stages) and 64-plane layered depth quadrature.
